title: Turkish-Style Stuffed Tofu (Manti)
description: A Turkish-inspired dish where tofu is stuffed with a blend of spices and herbs, then wrapped in crispy pastry and baked to perfection.

ingredients.name: Turkish Spice Blend
ingredients.notes: A mix of cumin, paprika, salt, and pepper

instructions: Wrap the tofu block in plastic wrap and bake for 15 minutes.
In a pan, heat 2 tbsp of oil over medium heat.
Add the finely chopped onion and cook until translucent.
Mix in the Turkish Spice Blend and cook for 1 minute.
Remove the tofu from the oven and let it cool.
Stuff the tofu with the onion-spice mixture.
Wrap each tofu piece with a piece of crispy pastry.
Place the wrapped tofu on a baking sheet lined with parchment paper.
Bake for an additional 15-20 minutes, or until the pastry is golden brown.
Garnish with chopped parsley and serve.
